name: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang
line: Modelled from plate 20 of 1783-86 and the plan's six flats a side; the two gates are the plate's, every flat's outline and relief is assumed, because the painted scenes are lost (C).
rows: the first pair of flats, nearest the water, as plate 20 draws them: rusticated piers, an arch 2.38 m wide to 6.55 m with radiating voussoirs, corbels under the cornice at 8.6 m, a hipped cap to 10.4 m with urns and a pineapple (11.65 m), a lion on a ball at each side (read at the plan's 7.3 m, C)

five more pairs of flats 7.3 m wide on S01's places, narrowing towards the back wall; cut to the outline of painted houses whose eaves fall towards the axis (from 8.2 m to 4.2 m), their roofs, windows and doors in low relief: assumed, the paintings are lost (S02: 'partly modeled and partly painted', C)
6 m with a range of hills on it (S02: a back wall, painted; its height and outline assumed, C)
6 steps 9 m wide with rounded ends from the stage down to 方河 on the axis (plate 20, C)
the flats' and the back wall's outlines and relief, every back with its bracing (C, the pale tint with conf=1); the two ranges at the ends are the kit's
